$comment: This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the expected values. The guard
(check-cyclomatic-bound.ts) reads the ACTUAL values from .oxlintrc.json and
compares them against this reference file. To change a ceiling you must edit
this file, and the test file (check-cyclomatic-bound.test.ts) independently
asserts these exact values, so a ceiling change touches three files in review.
The keys are the glob patterns that appear as `files` entries in .oxlintrc.json
overrides. The special key "__default__" maps to the root-level rules.complexity.
